grouping: Thematic import facades; existing source paths retained. Every original library module has exactly one primary group. Imports may cross groups.

ComplexGaussianHermite.title: Complex Gaussian and Hermite analysis
ComplexGaussianHermite.scope: Gaussian laws, moments, complex Hermite basis, completeness, Parseval and Wirtinger calculus.

GaussianLSI.title: Gaussian log-Sobolev and entropy
GaussianLSI.scope: Gaussian LSI via discrete approximation, entropy tensorization and analytic closure.

GinibreMeasureGeometry.title: Ginibre measure and holomorphic geometry
GinibreMeasureGeometry.scope: Concrete normalization, Vandermonde isometry, symmetry and holomorphic projection geometry.

WeakSobolev.title: Weak Sobolev domains and collision capacity
WeakSobolev.scope: Weak gradients, mollification, core approximation, collision removal and capacity; Appendix A.

DeficitsEquality.title: Poincaré deficits and equality
DeficitsEquality.scope: Sharp symmetric inequality, Hermite deficits and affine equality; supports Theorems 1.1, 1.9 and 1.10.

PolynomialRadial.title: Polynomial, radial and equilibrium sectors
PolynomialRadial.scope: Equilibrium factorization, Hermite–Laguerre eigenfunctions, Kostlan laws and radial LSI; Theorems 1.2, 1.4, 1.12.

GeneratorSemigroup.title: Diffusion operators and analytic semigroups
GeneratorSemigroup.scope: Generator domains, Bochner identities, curvature, resolvents and transition identification.

StochasticCalculus.title: Stochastic calculus foundations
StochasticCalculus.scope: Brownian integration, quadratic variation, Girsanov changes of law and finite-dimensional Itô formulas.

StochasticDynamics.title: Ginibre stochastic dynamics
StochasticDynamics.scope: Singular stochastic equation, Hamiltonian noise constructions, independence, CIR factorization and stationarity; Theorem 1.3.

MatrixLift.title: Matrix lift and eigenvector overlaps
MatrixLift.scope: Schur and spectral charts, matrix Gaussian law and finite-energy overlap inequalities; Theorem 1.13.

NonQuadratic.title: Nonquadratic potentials
NonQuadratic.scope: Weighted dbar, general-potential geometry, convex transports and radial LSI; Theorem 1.14.

Endgame.title: Paper assembly
Endgame.scope: Public completion endpoints and finite or abstract reduction assemblies.
